title: Derive the iHRIS site theme from the verified release
description: Measures the iHRIS Classic Manage colours and fonts from ihris-common/css/globalStyles.css and ihris-manage/css/themeStyles.css in the sha256-verified ihris-suite-4.3.3 tarball, in cascade order. Substitutes another measured colour, never an invented one, where a colour fails WCAG AA in its role, and records why. Copies the iHRIS logo with GPL attribution. --check fails when src/site/theme is stale; without the tarball it verifies the logo sha256 only.
